g.title: Hex 0131: Bastet UWP: A654956-E | Allegiance: Fe Bases: Naval, Scout Secondary Worlds: 6 (Gas Giants: 2, Belts: 0) Trade Codes: Hi, Ht History: Epoch II (-1851) (Rule of Man Seedship / Uplifted Terran Feline Freehold) Lore: Capital of the Chatelaine of Bastet (SCG 0131): a high-tech (TL14) Garden world settled in -1851 by genetically uplifted Terran cats (Felis catus sapiens) from the Rule of Man research vessel Caelum Felis.

Hex 0431: Pasht UWP: C544642-B | Allegiance: Fe Bases: None Secondary Worlds: 9 (Gas Giants: 2, Belts: 0) Trade Codes: Ag, Ni History: Epoch IV (610) (Uplifted Terran Feline Freehold) Lore: Border watch-post of the Chatelaine of Bastet monitoring spinward trade routes.
